### Sep 5 Cave Digest

- Gold down (-1.4%) = rising bond yields make non-yielding gold less attractive, dollar firmed too
- Silver down (-1.4%) = tracking gold move, not diverging
- Fear meter (VIX) up slightly = mild uptick, not scared territory
- Oil (WTI/Brent) up modestly = no clear driver in headlines, meh
- Dollar up slightly = matches yield move, boring
- ASX Materials down (-0.37%) = no China demand data in headlines to explain it, reason unclear

**Watch:**
- US 10Y yield direction - further rises could keep pressuring gold
- Any Hormuz/Middle East headl
